_notes: 所有人工修改的统一 delta log：merge / split / retype / relation correction 均记录于此，不限于少数例外。Accept 记录在 auto.human_review。
operations 保存基于原始 source spans 的规范化当前决定；history 保存撤销所需的先前决定与 review 状态，不参与 parser。
When operations is non-empty, source_lock is required and pins corrections to one corpus byte hash: { source_id, sha256 }.
Supported operations: set_type, set_relations, merge_units, split_unit.
Text corrections are not accepted here until they carry a versioned source-to-reading mapping.
